source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(height)).most_common(1)[0][0]
                 for c in range(width)]

    def separator_mode(modes):
        counts = Counter(modes)
        return min(counts, key=lambda value: (counts[value], value))

    row_separator = separator_mode(row_modes)
    col_separator = separator_mode(col_modes)
    row_lines = [r for r, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value == row_separator]
    col_lines = [c for c, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value == col_separator]

    result = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = (grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]])
            color = corners[0]
            if len(set(corners)) != 1 or color in (base, row_separator, col_separator):
                color = base
            row.append(color)
        result.append(row)

    while len(result) > 1 and all(value == base for value in result[0]):
        result.pop(0)
    while len(result) > 1 and all(value == base for value in result[-1]):
        result.pop()
    while len(result[0]) > 1 and all(row[0] == base for row in result):
        result = [row[1:] for row in result]
    while len(result[0]) > 1 and all(row[-1] == base for row in result):
        result = [row[:-1] for row in result]
    return result
'''
